correctness.rationale: The assigned source RESULT.md (blob 4b2089ce16feab5f95422468319fb91e22f8dc15) uses exact product graph distance d_Cn(i,j)+1_{a≠b}. When n>=7, every distance-two skip edge at columns i-1,i+1 has a simplicial common link on all m vertices of the middle fiber, and a simplex cannot contain two distinct such skip edges. Removing paired cones gives nm2^{m-1} free-face collapses. Remaining facets are the 2m-vertex consecutive-fiber simplices; removal of dominated colors leaves a single rim C_n. Counting nonempty faces gives additional n(4^m-2^m-2)/2 pairs, hence N=n(4^m+(m-1)2^m-2)/2. R1 is a graph of n contractible fiber simplices and nm linking edges, so beta1=n(m-1)+1 and its fixed-color rim maps onto the R2 generator, with kernel rank n(m-1). All parameters are n>=7,m>=3, inclusive shortest-path Rips, thresholds 1 and 2 only.
